stem:
Leela finds a dry dormant mustard seed, a potted mint plant, and a toy bus near the garden. She wants to decide which is living.

Which claims use the shared life characteristics correctly? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The dry dormant mustard seed is dead because it is not moving right now.
The potted mint plant is living because it shows life processes such as growth and needing food.
Living things are judged by shared life characteristics, not by one visible feature alone.
The toy bus rolling down a slope is living because it shows movement.

teacher.key_rationale: Living status rests on shared life characteristics, not on one visible sign such as movement. The mint plant shows life processes. A dormant seed is not proven dead by stillness alone. A rolling toy is non-living.
